response.sql: WITH account_averages AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS avg_amount, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), region_averages AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amount) AS avg_account_amount, AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_account_balance FROM account_averages GROUP BY region), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_account_amount) AS mean_region_amount FROM region_averages) SELECT r.region, r.avg_account_amount, r.avg_account_balance, r.avg_account_amount / o.mean_region_amount AS amount_ratio FROM region_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_region_amount IS NOT NULL
